newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Interest seen in Australia's Surat coal field.
newsitem.headline: Interest seen in Australia's Surat coal field.

text.p: The Surat-Dawson Valley thermal coal field in Queensland's south-west is attracting widespread interest both domestically and internationally, state Economic Development Minister Doug Slack said on Thursday.
The response follows an invitation by Queensland state to develop what it calls the state's "new resource frontier," Slack said.
In the first three days after calling for expressions of interest, 120 responses had been received, Slack said in a ministerial statement to parliament.
"They have come from leading engineering firms, finance and accounting firms, mining companies, as well as energy and construction companies in Queensland and interstate," he said.
Slack said private enterprise was also being encouraged to develop the necessary water, roads, power and rail connections.
The Surat Basin was Queensland's new resource frontier "whose time has now come", he said.
